# add scripts to manage golangci-lint fork

The same as [[DOT-165]] for the author's fork of `golangci-lint` ([kamilsk/golangci-lint](https://github.com/kamilsk/golangci-lint)), which bundled extra linters such as `looppointer` ([[DOT-170]]): scripts to sync the fork with upstream, rebase, tag and publish it to the personal Homebrew tap.
